latest_release.name: v1.9.36
latest_release.body:
- Fixed `console.settitle` to preserve an Administrator prefix, if present.
- Fixed an edge case that could cache failed ahead/behind counts (regression introduced in v1.9.35).
- Fixed [#915](https://github.com/chrisant996/clink/issues/915); 500 ms startup delay in conhost on Windows 10 (regression introduced in v1.9.35).
- Reduced logging noise in the `clink.log` file:
  - Suppress log entries about resetting mismatched stdout/stderr handles; it's normal and frequent, and doesn't need log entries.
  - Only log history statistics when trimming to fit `history.max_lines` or when compacting history to remove lines marked for deletion.
- Log beginning and end of input prompt while `debug.log_terminal` is enabled.
